page.overview:
Who is Aoi Rokushō?

A former instructor in Konoha, he tricked Idate Morino, his former pupil, to steal the legendary lightning chakra sword called the "Sword of the Thunder God", which had once belonged to Tobirama Senju, the Second Hokage, along with a secret scroll of how to use the sword at full potential. Idate was tricked into believing that this would grant him advancement to chūnin. Once the sword was in Aoi's hands, he fled the country with Idate, who was ashamed of his actions, and they went to Amegakure. When Ibiki Morino and two Anbu members caught up with them, Aoi had the Anbu quickly killed, and Ibiki ended up being captured by the Ame ninja, where Aoi then tortured him to read the scroll. Idate escaped under Ibiki's advice. As Aoi attacked Ibiki, the latter escaped as well. Aoi then later managed to become a jōnin of Amegakure.

Originally Aoi appeared to be a kind-hearted and patient man with an earnest desire to help others. When Ibate was saddened at failing the Chūnin Exams, he was the first to console the young genin. However, this was all a facade. In reality, Aoi is a shameless man with no loyalty to anyone but himself. Very opportunistic, he has no problem betraying his village and manipulating others to get what he wants. These traits have also led him to be very arrogant and overconfident in his abilities. Between his status in Amegakure and wielding of the Second Hokage's legendary sword, he believed himself to be invincible, getting very reckless in battle and likewise over-reliant on the sword.

While being recognised as a jōnin in Amegakure, Aoi's overall skill as such was dubious at best as his promotion to it was mainly due to selling secrets to Amegakure, having originally been only a chūnin in Konohagakure. Even with a powerful sword developed by the Second Hokage, he ended up defeated at the combined efforts of Naruto Uzumaki and Sasuke Uchiha, two genin-level shinobi.

Aoi's signature technique was the Senbon Shower, a technique which allows the user to rain down senbon on their opponents through the use of hidden mechanisms concealed within umbrellas. He combined the technique with poisoned senbon, giving his opponents a slow and painful death, along with the damage done by the senbon themselves. Along with using his senbon with his umbrella, he also uses them as a regular ninja tool; not incorporating it with ninjutsu in order to preserve chakra. The bare poisoned senbon gives him an advantage, as the senbon's poison paralyses his opponents. He’s also able to generate water waves capable of immobilising his opponents for a short time with his umbrella.
